2. Merge samples 
```{r}
# Add metadata
sample <- as.data.frame(bppnm.whole$orig.ident)
sample <- sample %>% mutate(conditions = ifelse(sample$`bppnm.whole$orig.ident` %in% c("Ctrl-1","Ctrl-2","Ctrl-3","Ctrl-4","Ctrl-5","Ctrl-6","Ctrl-7","Ctrl-8"),"Ctrl","PD1"))
sample <- sample %>% mutate(mouse = substr(sample$`bppnm.whole$orig.ident`, nchar(sample$`bppnm.whole$orig.ident`), nchar(sample$`bppnm.whole$orig.ident`)))
bppnm.whole[["Condition"]] <- sample$conditions
bppnm.whole[["Mouse"]] <- sample$mouse
```
```{r}
bppnm <- JoinLayers(bppnm.whole)
allgenes = rownames(bppnm) # Can't do this because layers aren't merged
gene_counts <- rowSums(GetAssayData(object = bppnm, layer = "count")[allgenes,]>0)
genes_keep <- names(gene_counts[gene_counts>=10])
bppnm.whole <- subset(bppnm.whole, features=genes_keep)
bppnm.whole
```

3. QC, clustering, and cell type marker identification
```{r}
bppnm.whole[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(bppnm.whole, pattern = "^mt-")
VlnPlot(bppnm.whole, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
plot1 <- FeatureScatter(bppnm.whole, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
plot2 <- FeatureScatter(bppnm.whole, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
plot1 + plot2
```
```{r}
bppnm.whole <- subset(bppnm.whole, subset = nFeature_RNA>300 & percent.mt < 5 & nFeature_RNA < 11000) # 29862 cells
bppnm.whole <- NormalizeData(object=bppnm.whole) # Normalize each sample separately
bppnm.whole <- FindVariableFeatures(object=bppnm.whole)
bppnm.whole <- JoinLayers(bppnm.whole) # Join counts into 1 Layer
all.genes <- rownames(bppnm.whole)
bppnm.whole <- ScaleData(object = bppnm.whole, features=all.genes)
#saveRDS(bppnm.whole,file.path(dir,"Analysis/bppnm.whole.rds"))
bppnm.whole <- RunPCA(object=bppnm.whole)
```
```{r}
DimPlot(object=bppnm.whole, reduction="pca",group.by="orig.ident",shuffle=T)
```
```{r}
bppnm.whole <- FindNeighbors(bppnm.whole, reduction="pca",dims=1:30)
bppnm.whole <- FindClusters(bppnm.whole, reduction="pca",resolution=0.3) # Identified 14 Clusters
bppnm.whole <- RunUMAP(bppnm.whole, dims=1:30,reduction="pca")
plot1 <- DimPlot(bppnm.whole, reduction="umap",label=T,shuffle=T)+NoLegend()
plot2 <- DimPlot(bppnm.whole, reduction="umap",group.by="orig.ident",shuffle=T)
saveRDS(bppnm.whole,file.path(dir,"Analysis/bppnm.whole.rds"))
bppnm.whole <- readRDS(file.path(dir, "Analysis/bppnm.whole.rds"))
```
```{r}
bppnm.whole <- RunHarmony(bppnm.whole, "orig.ident",reduction.use="pca",plot_convergence=T) # Harmonize over sample ids
DimPlot(object=bppnm.whole, reduction="harmony",group.by="orig.ident",shuffle=T)
bppnm.whole <- FindNeighbors(bppnm.whole,reduction="harmony",dim=1:30)
bppnm.whole <- FindClusters(bppnm.whole, reduction="harmony",resolution=0.25)
bppnm.whole <- RunUMAP(bppnm.whole, dims=1:30, reduction="harmony",reduction.name="umap_harmony")
p1 <- DimPlot(bppnm.whole, reduction="umap_harmony",label=T,shuffle=T)+NoLegend()
p2 <- DimPlot(bppnm.whole, reduction="umap_harmony",group.by="orig.ident",shuffle=T)
p3 <- DimPlot(bppnm.whole,reduction="umap_harmony",group.by="Condition",shuffle=T)
p1+p2+p3
bppnm.whole$EMT <- ifelse(bppnm.whole$celltype %in% c("Mes Cancer 1","Cycling Mes Cancer"),"Mesenchymal Cancer",ifelse(bppnm.whole$celltype %in% c("Epi Cancer 1","Cycling Epi Cancer"),"Epithelial Cancer",ifelse(bppnm.whole$celltype == "Epi Cancer 2","pEMT Cancer",as.character(bppnm.whole$celltype))))
Idents(bppnm.whole) <- "EMT"
Idents(bppnm.whole) <- "celltype"
bppnm.whole$celltype <- ifelse(bppnm.whole$celltype == "Epi Cancer 2","pEMT Cancer",as.character(bppnm.whole$celltype))
```

4. Compare cell type representation across all samples and between Ctrl and aPD1
```{r}
mycolors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(name="Paired", n = 12))(14)
clusters <- as.data.frame(table(bppnm.whole[[c("Condition","celltype")]]))
cancer_clusters <- c("Mes Cancer 1","Cycling Mes Cancer","pEMT Cancer","Epi Cancer 1","Cycling Epi Cancer")
clusters.tumor <- as.data.frame(table(tumor[[c("Condition","celltype")]]))
clusters.tumor <- clusters[clusters$celltype %in% cancer_clusters,]
clusters.tumor$celltype <- factor(clusters.tumor$celltype,levels=cancer_clusters)
ggplot(clusters.tumor, aes(fill=subcluster, y=Freq, x=Condition))+
  geom_bar(position="fill",stat="identity")+labs(x="Sample",y="Fraction") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#00A9FF","#8494FF","#C77CFF","#CD9600","#F8766D"))
ggplot(clusters.tumor, aes(fill=celltype, y=Freq, x=Condition))+
  geom_bar(position="fill",stat="identity")+labs(x="Sample",y="Fraction") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#00A9FF","#8494FF","#C77CFF","#E38900","#F8766D"))
```
```{r}
cluster_ident <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(tumor[[c("Condition","subcluster")]]))
cluster.tumor <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(tumor[[c("orig.ident","subcluster")]]))
cancer_ident <- cluster_ident[cancer_clusters]
nb <- rowSums(cluster_ident) #min(nb)
cluster_ident <- cluster_ident/nb
cluster_ident
# Subsample min(nb) of cells from each Sample
cluster.sample <- c()
for(i in 1:8){
  x <- sample(1:5,size=min(nb),prob=cluster_ident[i,],replace=T)
  cluster.sample <- c(cluster.sample,x)
}
cluster.pd1 <- c()
for(i in 9:16){
  x <- sample(1:5,size=min(nb),prob=cluster_ident[i,],replace=T)
  cluster.pd1 <- c(cluster.pd1,x)
}
cluster.sample <- table(cluster.sample)
cluster.pd1 <- table(cluster.pd1)
cluster.all <- t(data.frame(Ctrl=as.vector(cluster.sample),PD1=as.vector(cluster.pd1),row.names=cancer_clusters))

# Tumor cell-specific
cluster_ident$Epi <- cluster_ident$`Epi Cancer 1`+cluster_ident$`Cycling Epi Cancer`+cluster_ident$`Epi Cancer 2`
cluster_ident$Mes <- cluster_ident$`Mes Cancer 1`+cluster_ident$`Cycling Mes Cancer`
clusters <-cluster_ident[c("Epi","Mes")]
clusters <-clusters/rowSums(clusters)
clusters$ident <- rownames(clusters)
clusters$Condition <- c(rep("Ctrl",8),rep("PD1",8))
clusters <- clusters[order(clusters$Condition,clusters$Mes),]
clustersl <- melt(clusters,id=c("ident","Condition"))
colnames(clustersl) <- c("Ident","Condition","celltype","Freq")
clustersl$Ident <- factor(clustersl$Ident, levels=clusters$ident)
# Run T-tests
p_val = c()
for(i in 1:dim(cluster_ident)[2]){# Ctrl vs. aPD1, proportion test
  res <- prop.test(x=cluster_ident[1:2,i],n=rowSums(cluster_ident))
  p_val <- c(p_val,res$p.value)
}
for(i in 1:dim(cluster_ident)[2]){# Ctrl vs. aPD1, pseudo-bulk
  res <- t.test(cluster_ident[c(1:8),i],cluster_ident[9:16,i],var.equal=T)
  p_val <- c(p_val,res$p.value)
}
clusters <- as.data.frame(t(cluster_ident))
clusters <- clusters/colSums(clusters)
clusters$p_val <- p_val
clusters$signif <- clusters$p_val < 0.05/14
cluster_ident # Cutoff = 0.004
```

```{r}
pEMT.markers <- FindMarkers(tumor, ident.1="pEMT Cancer",ident.2="Epi Cancer 1")
# Epi clusters

epi.cycling.markers <- FindMarkers(tumor, ident.1="Epi Cancer 1",ident.2="Cycling Epi Cancer",logfc.threshold=0.5, min.pct = 0.25)
# Epi cancer 2?
epi2.markers <- FindMarkers(tumor, ident.1="Epi Cancer 2",ident.2=c("Epi Cancer 1","Cycling Epi Cancer"),logfc.threshold=0.5, min.pct = 0.25)
# Mes clusters
mes.markers <- FindMarkers(tumor, ident.1=c("Mes Cancer 1","Cycling Mes Cancer"),ident.2=c("Epi Cancer 1", "Cycling Epi Cancer"),logfc.threshold=0.25, min.pct = 0.25)
mes.cycling.markers <- FindMarkers(tumor, ident.1="Mes Cancer 1",ident.2="Cycling Mes Cancer", logfc.threshold=0.5, min.pct=0.25)
# Order genes by logfc
epi.markers <- epi.markers[order(epi.markers$avg_log2FC),]
epi.markers <- epi.markers[epi.markers$p_val_adj < 0.05,]
epi.cycling.markers <- epi.cycling.markers[order(epi.cycling.markers$avg_log2FC),]
epi.cycling.markers <- epi.cycling.markers[epi.cycling.markers$p_val_adj < 0.05,]
epi2.markers <- epi2.markers[order(epi2.markers$avg_log2FC),]
epi2.markers <- epi2.markers[epi2.markers$p_val_adj < 0.05,]
mes.markers <- mes.markers[order(mes.markers$avg_log2FC),]
mes.markers <- mes.markers[mes.markers$p_val_adj < 0.05,]
mes.cycling.markers <- mes.cycling.markers[order(mes.cycling.markers$avg_log2FC),]
mes.cycling.markers <- mes.cycling.markers[mes.cycling.markers$p_val_adj < 0.05,]
# Save DEG lists in excel
genesets <- list("Epi_1_Epi_Cycling_vs_All"=epi.markers, "Epi_1_vs_Epi_Cycling"=epi.cycling.markers,
                 "Epi_2_vs_Epi_1"= epi2.markers, "Mes_1_Mes_Cycling_vs_All"=mes.markers,
                 "Mes_1_vs_Mes_Cycling"=mes.cycling.markers)
write.xlsx(genesets,file.path(dir,"Analysis/Tumor_Clusters_DGE.xlsx"),rowNames=T)
```

6. GSEA Analysis
```{r}
# GSEA analysis
tmp1 <-which(mes.markers$avg_log2FC>0)
mes.markers<-mes.markers[tmp1,]

# Get gmt file
mouse_gene_sets = msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus")
msigdbr_collections()
mouse_hallmark = mouse_gene_sets %>% dplyr::filter(gs_cat == "H")
gene_sets = split(x=mouse_hallmark$gene_symbol,f=mouse_hallmark$gs_name)
```
```{r}
EMT.markers <- FindMarkers(tumor, ident.1="Mes Cancer 1",ident.2="Epi Cancer 1",min.pct=0.25,logfc.threshold=0.25)
cyclingEMT.markers <- FindMarkers(tumor, ident.1="Cycling Mes Cancer",ident.2="Cycling Epi Cancer",min.pct=0.25,logfc.threshold=0.25)
cyclingEMT1.markers <- FindMarkers(tumor, ident.1="Cycling Mes Cancer",ident.2="Epi Cancer 1",min.pct=0.25,logfc.threshold=0.25)
epi2.markers <- FindMarkers(tumor, ident.1="Epi Cancer 2",ident.2="Epi Cancer 1",min.pct=0.25,logfc.threshold=0.25)
prepdf <- function(df){
  dfsub <- df[order(df$avg_log2FC),]
  return(dfsub[dfsub$p_val_adj < 0.05,])
}
EMT.markers <- prepdf(EMT.markers)
cyclingEMT.markers <- prepdf(cyclingEMT.markers)
cyclingEMT1.markers <- prepdf(cyclingEMT1.markers)
```

```{r}
# Do Cycling Mes Cancer cell TNFa signaling correlate with higher T cell infiltration?
tumor.meta <- tumor@meta.data
tumor.meta <- tumor.meta[c("orig.ident","Condition","celltype","subcluster","Tnfa_pathway1")] # 4569 Cycling Mes cancer cells
# Calculate correlation, vs. randomly selected tumor cells 
colnames(immune_ident) <- gsub(" ","_",colnames(immune_ident))
metat <- merge(tumor.meta,immune_ident, by.x="orig.ident",by.y=0)
cycling.meta <- metat[metat$celltype=="Cycling Mes Cancer",]
# Pseudo-bulk of Cycling Cancer values
cycling.summary <- cycling.meta %>% group_by(c(orig.ident)) %>% summarize(Tnfa=mean(Tnfa_pathway1))
cycling.summary <- merge(cycling.summary,immune_ident,by.x="c(orig.ident)",by.y=0)
cycling.summary$PD1 <- factor(c(replicate(8,0),replicate(8,1)))
res <- lm(formula = (T_Cells ~ Tnfa),data=cycling.summary)
print(summary(res))
p_value = summary(res)$coef[2,4]
ggplot(cycling.summary,aes(Tnfa, T_Cells))+geom_point(aes(color=PD1)) +
   geom_smooth(method='lm',formula = y ~ x)+labs(x="Cycling Mes Cancer TNFa score",y="T Cells/Immune cells",title=paste("T cell ~ Cycling Mes TNFa p-value =",round(p_value,3),"R^2=",round(summary(res)$r.squared,3)))+theme(plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5))
```

```{r}
# Calculate and plot Immunotherapy-resistance and Axl signatures

icr.genes <- matchMMUsymbol(table$`Immune resistance (up)`)
```

```{r}
non_cancer_cluster <- setdiff(gsub(" ","_",colnames(cluster_ident)),cancer_clusters)

cell_table <- cbind(cancer_ident,myeloid_ident)

cancer_clusters <- gsub(" ","_",colnames(cancer_ident))
immune_clusters <- gsub(" ","_",unique(myeloid$cluster))
non_cancer_clusters <- gsub(" ","_", colnames(non_cancer_ident))
# Cell type representation
n_noncancer = length(non_cancer_cluster)
ncancer = length(cancer_ident)
#out <- array('list', dim=c(n_noncancer,ncancer),dimnames =list(non_cancer_cluster,cancer_clusters))
coef <- array(dim=c(n_noncancer,ncancer),
             dimnames =list(non_cancer_cluster,cancer_clusters))
p_value <- array(dim=c(n_noncancer,ncancer),
                 dimnames =list(non_cancer_cluster,cancer_clusters))
r_squared <- array(dim=c(n_noncancer,ncancer),
                   dimnames =list(non_cancer_cluster,cancer_clusters))
r <- array(dim=c(n_noncancer,ncancer),
                   dimnames =list(non_cancer_cluster,cancer_clusters))
#coef_pd1 <- array(dim=c(n_noncancer,ncancer),
#             dimnames =list(non_cancer_clusters,cancer_clusters))
#p_pd1 <- array(dim=c(n_noncancer,ncancer),
#             dimnames =list(non_cancer_clusters,cancer_clusters))
cell_table$PD1 <- c(replicate(8,0),replicate(8,1))
label <- c()

for (i in 1:n_noncancer){
  for (j in 1:ncancer){
    cluster = non_cancer_cluster[i]
    cancer = cancer_clusters[j]
    out <- lm(formula=paste(cluster, '~', cancer,"+PD1"),data=cluster_ident)
    print(summary(out))
    coef[i,j] <- summary(out)$coef[2,1]
    p_value[i,j] <- summary(out)$coef[2,4]
    #coef_pd1[i,j] <- summary(out)$coef[3,1]
    #p_pd1[i,j] <- summary(out)$coef[3,4]
    r_squared[i,j] <- summary(out)$adj.r.squared
    if(r_squared[i,j]<0){
      r[i,j]=0
    } else if(coef[i,j]>0){
      r[i,j] <- sqrt(r_squared[i,j])
    } else{
      r[i,j] <- (-sqrt(r_squared[i,j]))
    }
  }
}

heatmap1 <- pheatmap(r,color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "red"))(50),breaks=seq(-1,1,length.out=50))

col_1 <- heatmap1$tree_col$order
```

```{r}
bppnm.pd1 <- subset(bppnm.whole,subset= (Condition=="PD1") & (celltype != "Mes Cancer 2"))
# Function to make cellchat object
make_cellchat <- function(sobject){
  data.input = sobject@assays$RNA$data
labels <- Idents(sobject)
meta = data.frame(labels=labels, samples=as.factor(sobject$orig.ident),row.names=names(labels))
cellchat <- createCellChat(object = data.input, meta = meta, group.by = "labels")
return(cellchat)
}
```

```{r}
         color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "red"))(50),
         cluster_cols=F,cluster_rows=T,fontsize=8)
write.table(mes.immune,file.path(dir,"Analysis/mes_v_epi_immune_DEGs.txt"),sep="\t",quote=F,row.names = T)
```


6. Get mean regulon expression
```{r}
dir2 <- "~/Partners HealthCare Dropbox/Ning Guan/Lab Work- Alexa Mitchell/RNA_seq/BPPNM_10xFlex_Pilot2"
tumor.module <- tumor
regulons = read.table(file.path(dir2,"Analysis/top_regulons.csv"),header=T,sep="\t",row.names=NULL)
n_regulons = dim(regulons)[1]
genes = as.vector(unlist(regulons[1]))
for (i in 1:n_regulons){
  targets = strsplit(gsub('^.|.$', '', regulons[i,"Regulon"]),split=", ")
  # Calculate average expression per gene
  tumor.module = AddModuleScore(tumor.module, features=targets,ctrl=10,name=genes[i],seed=10)
}
cebpb_targets = strsplit(gsub('^.|.$', '', regulons[3,"Regulon"]),split=", ")
arnt_targets = strsplit(gsub('^.|.$', '', regulons[10,"Regulon"]),split=", ")
xbp1_targets = strsplit(gsub('^.|.$', '', regulons[9,"Regulon"]),split=", ")
```
```{r}
# Turn ModuleScore for each regulon into an assay
colnames(tumor.module@meta.data)[c(19:37)] = genes
regulators <- colnames(tumor.module@meta.data)[c(19:37)]
regulon_df <- t(as.data.frame(tumor.module@meta.data[regulators]))
rownames(regulon_df) <- genes
regulon_assay <- CreateAssayObject(counts=regulon_df)
tumor.module[["regulon"]] <- regulon_assay
head(tumor.module)
```

```{r}
# Run UMAP on TF.AUC assay

features <- rownames(bppnm.multi)
bppnm.multi <- NormalizeData(bppnm.multi, normalization.method = "CLR")
bppnm.multi <- RunUMAP(bppnm.multi, reduction.key="UMAPtf_",n.neighbors=20L,features=features)
DimPlot(bppnm.multi,label=T,repel=T)+NoLegend()
```

```{r}
# Identify and plot top 20 TF regulons for each tumor cell state
tumor <- subset(bppnm.multi,idents=c("Epi Cancer","Mes Cancer","Cycling Cancer"))
avg.regulon <- as.data.frame(AverageExpression(object = tumor)$TF.AUC)
avg.tumor <- AverageExpression(object = tumor,return.seurat = T)
top_regulons <- c()
for ( i in c("Epi Cancer","Mes Cancer","Cycling Cancer")){
  tfs <- rownames(avg.regulon[order(avg.regulon[[i]],decreasing=T),])[1:20]
  top_regulons <- union(top_regulons,tfs)
}

# Scale data and plot
tumor.matrix <- as.data.frame(avg.tumor@assays$TF.AUC@scale.data)
heatmap1 <- pheatmap(tumor.matrix[rownames(tumor.matrix) %in% top_regulons,],
         color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "red"))(50),
```
